resources.string: Lets one back swipe close the suggestion bar and go back in the app. While the Sym panel is open, TitanKeys also reads the keys you press, so Enter and Backspace turn its pages instead of going to the app. In the Smart Launcher search field, it reads the keys you press too, so Hold for symbols and two presses of Shift or Alt work. While you type, it also keeps the touchpad on the keys when a notification shows at the top of the screen. TitanKeys doesn\'t read your screen.
Copy something and it shows up here for an hour.
To pin a clip, press Enter, then the key under it.
Press the key under a clip to pin or unpin it
Press Backspace or Clear again. Pinned clips stay.

Clipboard. What you copied in the last hour, and the clips you pinned. Press the key under a clip to paste it. Swipe up or down for more, and left or right for Pinned. Enter pins, Backspace clears, and Alt goes back.
Older clips: press Sym, then A
To use names from your contacts, allow Contacts for TitanKeys here.
